requiredFindings.title: Separate regenerated-output checks from receipt freshness
requiredFindings.detail: LD-C1B-7 requires each sub-unit to re-pin and regenerate its affected artifacts, but then requires its census --check to fail specifically because the receipt is stale (also the changes table and section 6:200). The pinned implementation does not have that contract. discovery_census.py:1205-1218 renders a valid receipt with different bindings as outstanding stale rows; run():1373-1379 only compares regenerated bytes with the checked-in output. Once the required regeneration has happened, --check passes even while the receipt remains stale. snapshot_ledger_census.py:283-303 likewise compares generated output bytes, rather than asserting blind-receipt freshness. A failed output comparison is therefore not evidence of the expected stale receipt. As written, the lane cannot satisfy both regeneration and the mandated failure, and treating a comparison failure as expected can hide an actual artifact mismatch.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Require applicable generated-output --check commands to pass after each sub-unit's re-pin and regeneration. Record the expected receipt-binding mismatch/stale state separately, with exact changed bindings and the relevant published stale status, without relying on private held-out contents. Keep malformed receipts, bad pins, missing artifacts and output differences as failures. Specify a separate freshness assertion if one is needed; do not describe the existing --check as that assertion. After the reviewed final blind refresh, require both current bindings/receipts and passing artifact checks. Update the changes table, LD-C1B-7 and section 6 consistently.

requiredFindings.title: Resolve when the full VCS model and cap evidence become mandatory
requiredFindings.detail: The split at line 63 and LD-C1B-7:124 assign the VCS term in snapshot_ledger_model.py to C1b-2. However, LD-C1B-6:119 requires C1b-1's evidence to establish the fixed r9 caps under the full term, and section 8:214 still says C1b-1 adds that term. Round one's Q1 ruling explicitly required the complete term in the final snapshot recipe before acceptance of C1b-1. Moving the recipe implementation to C1b-2 leaves the plan without a consistent gate for accepting the Git-reading unit, whose new traversal, captures, buffers and retained values require that derivation. Deferring a physical blind refresh does not itself resolve this model-evidence timing conflict.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Choose and state one consistent owner and acceptance gate for the complete VCS term. Preserve the full derivation and fixed-cap/2x evidence before C1b-1 acceptance, preferably by assigning its model change to C1b-1 and updating the split and batch inputs accordingly. If a later model integration is intended, explicitly specify how the reviewed final model bytes and full evidence are supplied before C1b-1 acceptance and how they are preserved through C1b-2; do not silently defer the Q1 gate. Make LD-C1B-6, LD-C1B-7 and section 8 agree.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Remove the old C1b-0 refresh wording
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The C1b-0 ownership row still says materialization is followed by a reviewed blind refresh. The explicit order and LD-C1B-7 correctly put the single batch refresh after C1b-2. Align this row with that order to avoid suggesting a separate early refresh.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: Describe C1b-0 as opening the batch and refer to the single refresh after C1b-2.

openQuestionRulings.Q5: Yes. Re-confirm the exact accepted C1a4 refresh inputs, receipt pins and post-run review as the batch-entry baseline, and establish that its receipts were current for those inputs before C1b opened the stale interval. Once C1b changes the bindings, that receipt is historical baseline evidence only, not proof of freshness for the batch. The pre-run review must bind all final discovery and snapshot cost-source/recipe inputs; the post-run review must verify both resulting receipts against them. This adds no blind run and does not authorize reading held-out trees, stores or private results.
